title: Let a task name a question id as its blocker, clearing when the question resolves (seq 179d)
description:
opum-doc seq 179, item (d), relayed by opum-agent. Design: opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-in-quest-design.md at main.

A task can be blocked by a question: it names the question id, and the block clears when that question resolves rather than needing a second write. Today a task's blocked reason is unrecorded and unverifiable -- QCLI-251 records that the blockers field has no CLI write path at all -- so the first thing this task does is establish what the field ACTUALLY supports, and report that, rather than assuming it can carry a reference.

If the field cannot express a reference as it stands, that is a finding to report to opum-doc, not a design call to make locally.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A task can name a question id as its blocker through the CLI, and the block clears when that question resolves
What the blockers field supports today is MEASURED and reported, including whether it can carry a reference at all, before the shape is built on
A task blocked by an unresolved question is excluded from ready work, and returns when it resolves

implementationNotes: Re-ranked high to medium per the ODOC-480 grooming ruling (opum-ai/opum-doc#1621, 2026-11-04): no 0.16 plan names it. Searched docs/ and .quest/ for a 0.16 plan on 2026-11-04 and found none.

RULING, ODOC-607 (2026-11-18T22:45:04Z): not behind QCLI-447, and needs no write-path decision. A question blocker is derived at read time, so the task reads blocked while the question is open; measure the blockers field before building.

MEASUREMENT FIRST, per the ODOC-607 ruling, taken on dev 53f8d7b2 before any code. (1) SHAPE: blockers is an append-only event array of {kind: opened|cleared, blockId: any non-empty string, actorId, at, reason?, evidence?} (src/domain/tasks/tasks.ts:426); blockId is an untyped free string, so it CAN carry a question reference like Q-7, but nothing validates it, tags it as a question, or resolves it. (2) WRITE PATH: there is none - quest manifest advertises no blocker write flag, task edit has no open/clear flag, and the CLI surface (main.ts, command-contract.ts, command-help.ts) has no blocker writer; QCLI-251 was closed as superseded and its final summary says the gap is not fixed. (3) READY: an active uncleared blocker already excludes a task from task list --ready with exclusion reason explicitly_blocked (src/domain/tasks/tasks.ts:1315), so the exclusion half of AC3 is true today for any blocker. (4) DATA: 0 records across .quest/tasks/ and .quest/completed/ carry a blocker, and .quest/questions/ does not exist yet, so there are no question records to resolve against. (5) IDS: question ids are Q-<n> validated by ^Q-[1-9][0-9]*$ in src/domain/questions/questions.ts. CONCLUSION: the field can carry the reference, so this is not the report-a-design-gap branch; the work is a write path plus read-time derivation (a block whose blockId names an OPEN question is active and goes inactive when that question resolves or is withdrawn, with no second write), exactly as ruled.
